en.title: Supporting evidence
en.p1: Please upload any supporting evidence that shows you have a criminal record or conviction. This could include:

ul.li4: any other official documents relating to the offence

en.p2: Select the files you want to upload. You can select a maximum of X files.

ul1.li2: Have filenames that are unique and contain only letters A to Z, numbers, full stops, spaces, underscores, hyphens and round brackets
ul1.li3: Have filenames that end with PDF, DOC, DOCX, JPEG, JPG, PNG, CSV, TXT, TIF, XLS, XLSX, ODT, ODP, or ODSs

details1.p2: Your files must not be password protected or edited using software like Photoshop, as these may be rejected.
details1.p3: You can only upload 100MB at a time.
